newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Kim orders probe on ex-defence minister.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Kim orders probe on ex-defence minister.

text.p: South Korean President Kim Young-sam has ordered an investigation into a suspected bribery scandal involving a former defence minister, an official at the presidential office said on Saturday.
"President Kim ordered the prosecution to investigate into the case to find out the truth," a Blue House official said by telephone.

Opposition lawmakers accused former defence minister Lee Yang-ho of leaking classified military information on a combat helicopter project to an arms dealer in 1995 in return for 150 million won ($181,000) in bribes.
Prosecution officials could not immediately confirm on Saturday whether an investigation had started and what charges Lee might face.
Lee lost his defence portfolio on Thursday in a reshuffle of the nation's top military brass, a move seen as linked to last month's incursion by a North Korean submarine.
The submarine ran aground off South Korea's east coast city of Kangnung. Of the 26 North Koreans on board, 22 have been killed or found dead and one captured.
A manhunt continued on Saturday for the three remaining infiltrators, who are believed to be hiding in mountainous areas near Kangnung.
